justification: This batch changes regulatory-adjacent user-facing claims on three surfaces: the bushfire compliance fields stop asserting a blanket RFS referral and 10/50 clearing entitlement that the statute makes conditional, the SEPP context and capacity cards stop describing conservation and rural zones as centre or business zones, and the brief's gap labels stop describing a failed lookup as intentional scope. Wrong wording here is a silent liability defect on a compliance product, so each change carries a guard test that pins the corrected sentence or the three-state semantics.

pre_impl.existing_data: A live brief for 20 Patanga Street Kincumber showed the defects on deployed main: the C4 Environmental Living lot rendered centre-zone shop-top housing copy, the bushfire card asserted RFS referral required Yes while listing triggers that contradict it, the Valuer General land value fetch miss rendered as Not part of this brief, and the plan overlay printed raw key equals value strings for the bushfire and lot-dimension composites.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The bushfire service derived both rfs_referral_required and clearing_10_50_entitled directly from is_bushfire_prone, but referral under the Rural Fires Act attaches only to trigger developments and the 10/50 scheme follows the RFS entitlement area map, so bushfire-prone alone cannot answer either question.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing three-state None convention already used across the compliance payload rather than adding new fields beyond one rfs_referral_note string; the zone-family switch extends the existing regulatory-constants helpers instead of adding a permitted-use table; the record-dump guard extends the existing brief_templates sentence builders and its import-time liability audit.

functions.name: _build_compliance
functions.input: the RFS mapping result for a lot including is_bushfire_prone and the estimated BAL band plus any intersecting overlays and the zone
functions.output: a compliance object whose referral and 10/50 fields are None with conditional wording and the trigger list when the land is bushfire prone, and definitive False only when the land is not prone
functions.if_none: when the RFS lookup itself failed every compliance field stays None so no surface can render a definitive referral or clearing claim from an unknown mapping state

values.read_at: BushfireResultCard and the bushfire PDF template read both fields when rendering the development implications block for a prone lot
values.if_missing: a null or undefined value renders the conditional wording with the trigger list and the entitlement-area-map note rather than a definitive Yes or No claim

break_it.scenario: A bushfire-prone lot renders the compliance block in the PDF where the referral field arrives as undefined rather than null after JSON round-tripping
break_it.what_happens: a strict triple-equals null check would fall through to the boolean branch and print No for a lot where referral is genuinely proposal-dependent
break_it.how: the PDF template uses a loose double-equals null comparison that catches both null and undefined and prints the proposal-dependent wording
break_it.repro: render bushfire-report with compliance rfs_referral_required undefined and confirm the output reads Depends on the proposal rather than No

break_it.scenario: A brief runs on a conservation or rural zone such as C4 Environmental Living or RU2 and reaches the SEPP context and dwelling-yield copy
break_it.what_happens: the previous binary residential-or-not switch described every non-residential zone as a centre or business zone delivering shop-top housing, which is false outside the centres zones
break_it.how: zoneFamily classifies residential rural conservation centres and other separately and the shop-top sentence renders only for the centres family while other families point at the LEP land-use table
break_it.repro: render SeppContextCard with zone C4 and confirm the copy names a conservation zone and never contains shop-top housing

break_it.scenario: An overlay sentence template receives a composite record value that serialises to key equals value pairs joined by semicolons
break_it.what_happens: the raw internal string such as is_bushfire_prone equals True with category and BAL fields would render verbatim in the reader-facing plan overlay
break_it.how: looks_like_record_dump detects record-shaped values in every generic sentence builder and renders the section-card reference instead while the bushfire and lot-dimension composites get authored sentences
break_it.repro: call the overlay sentence builder with a record-shaped value and confirm the output is the section reference sentence with no equals signs

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run the Kincumber brief on the preview and confirm the SEPP card describes a conservation zone with no shop-top sentence, the bushfire card shows the conditional referral and 10/50 wording with triggers, the land value gap reads Unavailable with a retry instruction, and the plan overlay contains no key equals value strings; full pytest and jest suites plus tsc ran clean in the worktree before push.
